$comment: after an edit to a shader, a scene, or a system whose output is motion —
so an unattended run always has a current sheet to look at.
It is off by default and the guard is deliberate. A capture is ~5 seconds
of GPU work; firing it after every file write would cost more than the
work it is watching. The matcher below is narrow on purpose: shaders and
scenes only, never Rust, never docs, never a cargo check.

hooks.command: if [ "${LOOM_AUTO_WATCH:-0}" = "1" ]; then f=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); case "$f" in *.slang|*.loom) tools/watch.sh "${LOOM_WATCH_SCENE:-homestead}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac; fi
